_comment: Authoring source for docs/l1-unit-tests/*.csv. Test ID, Coverage Technique and Covers are read from the @DisplayName / it() strings in the test sources by scripts/l1-testcases.py, so they are never duplicated here. This file holds only what cannot be derived: SRS Reference, Priority, Given/When/Then, Negative? and Notes. Status is filled by the same script from surefire/vitest reports.

  (2026-06-01, 09:00, 09:00) → valid (equal times)
  (2026-06-01, 09:00, 10:00) → valid
  (2026-06-02, 09:00, 08:00) → valid (multi-day, not checked)
  (2026-06-01, null, 08:00)  → valid
  (2026-06-01, 09:00, null)  → valid
L1-BV-06.t: Only single-day records with both times present are checked\nInvalid input throws BadRequestException containing 'End time'
L1-BV-06.notes: @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource — each of the 4 conjunction terms driven independently

validator.validateEvidenceMetadata('image/jpeg', fileSizeBytes)

L1-BV-11.block: Block: TrainingLegacyDurationParser.parse()  |  BV-05 minute 0–59, BV-06 threshold 24

parser.parse(raw)

parser.parse(raw)

L1-BV-20.block: Block: CosineUtil.cosine()  |  the similarity primitive behind BV-07…BV-09
L1-BV-20.t: Returns 1.0, 0.0 and 0.6 — equals the true cosine for unit vectors

L1-BV-21.t: Returns 0 — negative dot products are clamped, so no threshold can be met by an inverse match

L1-BV-22.t: First two return 0\nThird returns 1.0 — only min(length) components are compared, no ArrayIndexOutOfBounds

L1-BV-23.g: A non-normalised vector compared with itself
L1-BV-23.t: Returns 4.0, not 1.0 — the method is a dot product, so callers MUST supply L2-normalised vectors\nDocuments the precondition so a future change fails loudly here
L1-BV-23.notes: Guards every similarity threshold at once

L1-BV-24.g: Published exam paper and one target user stubbed\nassignmentRepository.save captures the persisted entity\n@ParameterizedTest @CsvSource — 6 points

service.create(request with maxAttempts, 'admin')

  1    → 1  (BVA-Min)
  10   → 10 (BVA-Max)
  11   → 10 (BVA-Max+1, clamped down)

L1-FE-04.block: Block: httpClient response interceptor — silent refresh  |  TDS Part 2.2, AUTH_001
L1-FE-04.g: accessToken = 'stale', refreshToken = 'refresh-1'\nMSW: GET /orders → 401 on call 1, 200 on call 2\nMSW: POST /auth/refresh-token → { accessToken: 'fresh', refreshToken: 'refresh-2' }

POST /auth/refresh-token called exactly once
GET /orders called twice; the retry carried 'Bearer fresh'
Response resolves with the real data — the user sees no error
sessionStorage now holds 'fresh' / 'refresh-2'

L1-FE-08.t: Promise rejects and POST /auth/refresh-token is never called for any of the 5 auth paths — no refresh loop on the auth endpoints themselves

L1-FE-10.t: Rejects with response.status 500\nRefresh never called; accessToken unchanged
